name: DrawingRevisionRegister
tagline: Drawing log, revisions, superseded sets, transmittals and acknowledgements – document control in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete drawing document-control module for construction and engineering: every drawing revision goes through WIP, independent check, approval and issue on a numbered transmittal; the previous revision is superseded automatically, recipients' acknowledgements are tracked against a working-day deadline and the drawing issue sheet stays current. ISO 19650 P/C revisions (or letters / numbers), current set vs all revisions, phone-ready. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, starts in demo mode and connects to any table in a few clicks.
features: Current set with superseded chains, or every revision
ISO 19650 P01/C01 revisions (or letters / numbers) with next-revision suggestion and sequence checks
Contractual purpose needs a C revision
Issue approved revisions on numbered transmittals – previous revision superseded automatically
Distribution, acknowledgement tracking in working days, reminders and overdue flags
Classic drawing issue sheet (drawings × transmittals) with CSV export
New revision from any issued drawing
Cover sheet text, reminders and exports through OnAction
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; read-only and disabled states
controlType: standard (2 controls: DrawingRevisionRegister dataset + DrawingRevisionRegisterPortal field)
